blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Impeachment trial prosecutor and Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon called the camp of Vice President Sara Duterte’s claim that the House prosecution had failed to establish its case a “deluded statement.” READ: Sara Duterte’s spox: Prosecution in impeach trial failed to prove its case Lawyer Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr., the vice president’s spokesperson, earlier fired back at the prosecution team and said that Duterte will now have the chance to defend herself after their unsuccessful presentation. “A bit deluded statement, to say the least,” Ridon responded on Saturday, Nov. 7.
